configuration.title: ChatGPT Speech
configuration.auth.tokenSource.markdownD: ChatGPT session token source. Use `webSessionFile` for a saved session JSON file that can be silently refreshed from saved ChatGPT cookies, `user` for a raw token pasted into settings, or `codex` to read Codex auth live before each request without copying it.
configuration.auth.token.description: Raw ChatGPT accessToken when tokenSource = user. You can paste the accessToken from https://chatgpt.com/api/auth/session.
configuration.auth.webSessionTokenPath.d: Path to a ChatGPT session JSON file or raw bearer token when tokenSource = webSessionFile. If it expires, saved cookies are used to refresh it via https://chatgpt.com/api/auth/session.
configuration.externalCallbacks.allowedD: HTTPS callback domains allowed to receive a captured ChatGPT session through a `vscode://yasich217.chatgpt-speech/refresh-session?callback=...` URI. Empty means disabled. Entries match exactly; use `*.example.com` to allow subdomains. User-level only.
configuration.externalCallbacks.caFile.d: Optional PEM CA certificate file for approved external callbacks. Supports ${home} and ~. User-level only.
configuration.transcription.language.des: Language hint, for example ru or en. For ChatGPT web, ru is mapped to ru-RU.
configuration.insert.trimTranscript.desc: Trim whitespace before inserting the transcript.
configuration.recorder.command.descripti: Recorder executable on the VS Code UI host. Use a full path if ffmpeg is not on PATH.
configuration.recorder.args.description: Recorder arguments. Leave empty to use the platform default ffmpeg arguments. ${file} is replaced with the temporary WAV path.
